summary: The selected work-programme workflow writes the existing bounded runner JSON to an attempt result file, preserves the runner step exit, and independently displays and uploads the file through always() steps; a missing result fails upload. Runner reporting covers its file write, while GitHub step outcomes establish display and artifact acquisition. This source route retains the original runner and job budgets and adds no execution authority. The owning diagnostic plan retains exact hosted/artifact acceptance and evaluation; one clean observation and successful artifact readback do not establish native adoption, defect-yield benefit, total diagnostic overhead or savings. A published package does not establish native adoption or process custody; each selected receiver still needs its own admitted qualification. Source delivery, publication, installed receiver behavior, process cleanup and reporting remain separate assertions; V2-DIAG-01.4 is the completion authority. At the cited Client source, the production mutation fence refuses missing durable operation scope, protected authority, journal and provider reconciliation. Successful typed draft validation is not request delivery or installed authority; a refused room read is not an empty room. The owning plan retains the current root-reported intake refusal and unresolved supplying-owner gap. Preserve the draft until the programme root and owning admission authority establish a supported route; do not bypass the refusal with direct issue creation.
title: Ordinary diagnostic result retention and native acceptance remain separate
